title: POST /app/pair, 202
description: The code was right: the request waits for the owner, who sees the same number on the server.

pairing.description: The request's ticket: 128 random bits, base64url without padding. Only the phone that made the request has it

number.description: Six random digits for this request only, shown as 482 913

expires_in.description: Whole seconds left to confirm (at most 120)
